description: Domain profile for Data Engineering DAGs, Polars/DuckDB vectorized execution, and schema enforcement.
target_stack: Python / Polars / DuckDB / Airflow / Delta Lake
discovery_questions: Is execution Batch, Micro-batch, or Real-time Streaming?
Is schema enforced strictly at ingest or Schema-on-Read?
How are node retries and idempotency handled?
What are the memory and dataset scale constraints?
How are corrupt rows handled (Fail-fast vs Dead-Letter Queue)?
